arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with strong, catchy hooks; minimal variation; modern sample chopping techniques applied.

event_markers.label: Slice
event_markers.reason: Intro uses sliced drum samples to set the mood

event_markers.label: Chop
event_markers.reason: Hook features chopped drum hits for energy

event_markers.label: Stutter
event_markers.reason: Hook employs stutter effect on melodic samples

event_markers.label: Sparse Verses
event_markers.reason: Vocals minimal and sparse during verses

sample_layer.description: Modern sample chopping techniques applied on drums and melody layers.

sound_intent.overall: Uplifting Boom Bap with spacious verses and energetic hooks, minimal variation emphasizing sample chops.

routing_intent.drums: split slices and chops routed to separate channels named by chopping technique
routing_intent.melody: stuttered sample phrases routed on dedicated melody chop channel

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic foundation using sliced and chopped samples
track_roles.vocal: Sparse vocal phrases during verses and strong presence in hooks

designer_intent.focus: Capturing Boom Bap essence with modern sample chopping; keep verses minimal, hooks energetic and uplifting.

presetor_intent.goal: Apply presets that emphasize warmth and clarity of samples and chopped effects.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum tracks emphasizing modern slicing and chopping techniques, with sparse activity in verses and strong hooks.

bass_generator.brief: Create minimal bass lines that complement sparse verses and support energetic hooks.

harmony_generator.brief: Add minimal chord stabs with low activity, supporting the uplifting mood.

melody_generator.brief: Develop hook melodies using sample chopping and stutter techniques while keeping verses sparse.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate arrangement focusing on minimal variation, sparse verses, and energetic hook sections.

presetor.brief: Select and apply appropriate effects and sample presets to enhance chopping techniques and maintain clarity.

songgps.brief: Manage section transitions and energy curve reflecting sparse verses and strong, uplifting hooks.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance channels to highlight chopped samples in drums and melody; maintain clear vocal presence in hooks.
